title: PARAMO Ecuador Public Visualization Data Layer
description: Minimum public chart-ready data layer supporting PARAMO Ecuador Results Explorer v2.5.0. The release rebuilds the national 24-bus representative trajectories with robust_multimetric selection, adds aggregate transmission-investment and hydro-seasonality views, and publishes only the existing 230/500 kV physical grid plus independently switchable PARAMO reduced networks. Full model results and realization-level datasets are not included.
